classification: One finite-camera-region witness construction from original inputs; no terminal-solver restart
target: lean_center original measured standing rear camera and box armchair back
new_mechanism: Each fixed8x8 image-cell tile has five sufficient separating halfspaces (left/right/top/bottom/front). Choose one per noncontact body/tile by maximum worst margin across ORIGINAL standing and ORIGINAL analytic seed hulls, freeze choices before optimization. Keep original detailed pelvis and full-camera return audit. This preserves finite angular support rather than extending one plane across the whole camera view.
initialization: Original current encoder/hull/support-plane analytic seed with unchanged6.01mm torso-pelvis reserve; no prior endpoint/vector read. Witness selection includes original standing hull. No reselection or retry after launch.

equations.equilibrium: sum F=[0,0,W]; sum p cross F = COM cross [0,0,W]; full23joint gravity minus fixed-material contact Jacobian torque
equations.contact: Endpoint point = root*FK(body)*constant local material; every body vertex remains nonpenetrating and endpoint point lies on observed plane. Load transfer uses that same material. Marker comes only from the original analytic seed; unloaded backward approach retains exposed-min geometry.
equations.objective: full23joint squared torque / original standing torque + readiness epigraph squared + .05 joint deviation squared + .05 fixed-material tangent error squared / .15^2 + normalized root lowering squared; backward connection adds .1 endpoint-guided posture distance squared + .01 interval seconds
equations.clock: joint command arc/.125; normal joint arc/.05 and .003/.0055 per normal edge; 0.5s explicit quiet reserve plus actual25CURRENT requirement; >=.25s/load edge; 1s settle; complete settled trajectory<14.4s
equations.optimization: SLSQP60iterations per named endpoint/edge,ftol1e-9; success mandatory, equality<=.002 and inequality>=-1e-6; total parent45s cap overrides all stages

resources.timeout_output: process receipt and already written seed/endpoint audit; no salvaged point admission
resources.source_operations: For T<=2ceil((h-1)/8)ceil((w-1)/8) tiles and B<=38 bodies: facet conversion plus at most5BT original-hull minimum evaluations; retained plane rows bounded by5BT,31variables,60SLSQP iterations per named node,13nodes maximum. All actual hash/init/row/solve/audit work stays inside45s parent cap.

finite_return: Reject unless complete path, fullmesh, between-node feet/normal speed, float32 action bounds/filter/fingers and hold reserve pass; current-input runtime, ankle quiet and actual physical fullrollout gates still separately required.
limitations: Quasi-static model is not realized balance or contact force
ImplicitPD torque proxy is not physical energy
Sampled audit is not continuous geometry proof
Same-pose load transfer is a restriction; failure is not robot impossibility
Raw joint velocity guards remain unchanged
No simulation/PPO autostart on model pass
Exact derivatives may not resolve constrained optimization; failure remains reject, no retry/resume or iteration increase.
A fixed region witness may restrict the complete path. No branch reselection, tile-size tuning or follow-on solve is permitted on failure.

derivatives.FK: Forward chain-rule derivative of original root rotation-vector and joint-axis transforms; full23active joints plus6floatingbase coordinates
derivatives.forces: Differentiate exact full6D equilibrium and both foot force allocations; no force or motor sensor claimed

Row values must match original compressed rows to1e-10. Unknown rows derivative0, no free-space claim. Nonsmooth ties retain a piecewise derivative; no averaging or margin relaxation.

These are derivative implementation checks, not changed feasibility tolerances.

fixed_link_correction: Match original BodyModel.fk: fixed joints absent from encoder names have zero rotation, no axis lookup. Prior v1 stopped before derivative validation and optimization; no scientific point reused. Other equations/gates unchanged.

region_proof.plane: Original camera-coordinate facet margin at p=z*[u,v,1] is z*N.ray+alpha-delta with delta=.006. Convert original world planes through the exact affine transform used by the original projection.
region_proof.premise: alpha>delta for every selected facet; finite positive front cutoff; reject otherwise.
region_proof.front: For each facet D=max over4rectangle corners(-N.ray). For D>0 let cut=(alpha-delta)/D; tile cutoff=min facet cut. Facets with D<=0 are automatically safe on positive rays. For any positive-z query in that tile and z<=cut, every assigned original plane meets delta.
region_proof.other_four: Outside any one rectangle side the query cannot select any pixel triangle assigned to that tile. The original z>.08 domain is retained.
region_proof.body: Enforce selected affine halfspace at EVERY original hull vertex; original material samples are convex combinations of them. Choose a single witness per body/tile from five fixed alternatives using only original start/seed hulls. Freeze for whole solve.
region_proof.coverage: Tile integer cell indices partition every original pixel triangle; feet exclude original ground facets only; contact pelvis retains original per-facet rule.
region_proof.dedup: Only bit-identical normals are merged, keeping minimum offset (strongest inequality). Persist every tile/facet and body/choice association.
region_proof.limitations: Conservative continuous region may still reject feasible paths; body support and motion are not certified until all original gates pass. No relaxation of full-original clearance.
region_proof.boundary: All four outside halfspaces have a10micrometre inward reserve after normalization: equality on an included pixel edge never certifies outside. This strengthens construction only; original physical margins unchanged.
